biology_positive.interpretation: Prospective synthetic positive control of one latent standard-deviation unit. This magnitude is not a biological threshold and must not be tuned from the resulting observables.

required_invariants: donor/source/operator assignments identical across all control worlds
measurement-null hidden biological truth identical byte-for-value
biology-positive changes only the predeclared z_global coordinate in targeted cells
structural feature availability unchanged between reference and biology-positive worlds
measurement seed matched between reference and biology-positive worlds
hidden truth never serialized into model-facing outputs
claim_boundary: Control materialization only. No learned JEPA state is evaluated and no biological claim is qualified.
